question: Where are the hottest places on Earth?
answer:
The three highest temperatures the WMO accepts were all recorded in deserts below or near sea level.

Death Valley holds the record at 56.7 °C, set in 1913. The two most recent records, in Kuwait and Pakistan, are both from the last ten years.
